# Contract: Video Upload

*Generated by spec-writer. Hand edits are overwritten on regeneration.*

## Prerequisites

These conditions describe the environment in which items in this
contract are exercised. Producing them is part of the feature's
deliverable, alongside the implementation itself — a contract whose
prerequisites are not yet satisfied is not failing, it is still being
built. Once the feature is delivered, any missing condition halts item
execution until it is restored.

**Runtime services:**
- the backend HTTP service (`apps/backend`) is running, migrated against its PostgreSQL database, and reachable
- the `apps/web` Next.js application is running (dev server or production build) and reachable by a browser, with its proxy Route Handlers able to reach the backend service
- a browser (or browser-automation engine) is available to drive UI and E2E items
- `ffmpeg` and `ffprobe` are available on `PATH` wherever the backend process runs

**Persistent state:**
- a user exists with name "Existing User", email "existing@example.com", and password "ValidPass123" (the same fixture account established by the Authentication System feature), not suspended, not an admin. Used by: API-UPLOAD-01, API-UPLOAD-02, API-UPLOAD-03, API-LIST-01, UI-UPLOAD-01, UI-UPLOAD-02, UI-UPLOAD-03, UI-UPLOAD-04, UI-UPLOAD-05, E2E-UPLOAD-01, E2E-UPLOAD-02.

**Static inputs:**
- `video-samples/tiny-valid.mp4` — a small (a few seconds, well under 1MB) valid MP4 file with both a video and an audio stream, one of the accepted formats. Used by: API-UPLOAD-01, API-LIST-01, UI-UPLOAD-01, UI-UPLOAD-02, UI-UPLOAD-05, E2E-UPLOAD-01, E2E-UPLOAD-02.
- `video-samples/audio-only.mp4` — a small, valid MP4 **container with an audio stream only** (no video stream): duration is probable, but there is no video frame to extract a thumbnail from. Used by: API-UPLOAD-02.
- `video-samples/unsupported-format.txt` — a small plain-text file carrying a disallowed extension. Used by: API-UPLOAD-03, UI-UPLOAD-04.

**Configuration:**
- the frontend recognizes a cookie named `videomax_session` (any non-empty value) as an "authenticated visitor" signal, per the Authentication System feature. Used by: UI-UPLOAD-01 through UI-UPLOAD-05, E2E-UPLOAD-01, E2E-UPLOAD-02.
- the backend's session-signing key is configured and stable for the duration of a run. Used by: every item (all resolve a session to authenticate).
- the frontend's internal backend base URL is configured and points at the running backend service. Used by: every UI and E2E item, since all of them traverse the proxy.
- the backend's local-disk storage root is configured and points at a writable directory for the duration of a run. Used by: every item that stores a file — API-UPLOAD-01, API-UPLOAD-02, API-LIST-01, UI-UPLOAD-01, UI-UPLOAD-02, UI-UPLOAD-05, E2E-UPLOAD-01, E2E-UPLOAD-02 (UI-UPLOAD-03, UI-UPLOAD-04, and API-UPLOAD-03 reject before any file is stored).

## Quality gates

Each gate must pass for the feature to be considered ready.

- **Backend architecture audit** — `npm run gates` — the consolidated backend check (TypeScript compiles with no errors, ESLint reports no errors, dependency-cruiser reports no forbidden cross-layer imports, the structural architecture check passes, madge reports no circular imports, knip reports no orphaned files/exports) succeeds as a whole.
- **Backend tests** — `npm run test --workspace apps/backend` — the Vitest suite (domain, use case, and gateway/handler tests) passes.
- **Backend build** — `npm run build --workspace apps/backend` — the TypeScript production build completes without errors.
- **Frontend lint** — `npm run lint --workspace apps/web` — ESLint reports no errors across the frontend app.
- **Frontend typecheck** — `npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web` — TypeScript compiles with no type errors (`tsc --noEmit`).
- **Frontend unit/component tests** — `npm run test --workspace apps/web` — the Vitest + React Testing Library suite passes.
- **Frontend end-to-end tests** — `npm run test:e2e --workspace apps/web` — the Playwright suite passes against a running build.
- **Frontend build** — `npm run build --workspace apps/web` — the Next.js production build completes without errors.

## Coverage Manifest

| PRD Acceptance Criterion | Covered by |
|---|---|
| User can upload MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, or AVI files up to 2GB via drag-and-drop or file picker | API-UPLOAD-01, UI-UPLOAD-01 |
| Upload progress shows filename, percentage, and bytes transferred | UI-UPLOAD-02 |
| Files above 2GB are rejected before transfer with a clear message | UI-UPLOAD-03 |
| Unsupported extensions are rejected before transfer with a clear message | UI-UPLOAD-04, API-UPLOAD-03 |
| After a successful upload, the video appears in the library with its extracted thumbnail and status `validating` | API-UPLOAD-01, UI-UPLOAD-01, E2E-UPLOAD-01 |
| Thumbnail extraction failure falls back to a placeholder and does not block processing | API-UPLOAD-02 |
| User can continue browsing the library while the upload is in progress | UI-UPLOAD-05 |

## HTTP API

**Verification mode:** Send an HTTP request to the running backend service; assert response status, headers, body, and any direct persisted side-effect.

### Upload

**Common given:** the backend is running with default configuration; the authenticated user has no prior videos.

#### `API-UPLOAD-01` — happy path stores the file and probes its metadata
- given: (default)
- when: POST /videos with `video-samples/tiny-valid.mp4` as the multipart file part
- then:
  - response is `201` with body `{ id, status: "validating", durationSeconds: a positive number, containerFormat: "mp4" }`
  - the response's `thumbnailUrl` is non-null
  - a video row now exists for this user with that id, status `validating`, and the same duration

#### `API-UPLOAD-02` — thumbnail extraction failure does not block the upload
- given: (default)
- when: POST /videos with `video-samples/audio-only.mp4`
- then:
  - response is `201` with a non-null `durationSeconds`
  - the response's `thumbnailUrl` is null
  - the video row is persisted with status `validating` despite the missing thumbnail

#### `API-UPLOAD-03` — unsupported format rejected at the API boundary
- given: (default)
- when: POST /videos with `video-samples/unsupported-format.txt`
- then:
  - response is `422` with `code: "UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT"`
  - no video row is created

### List

#### `API-LIST-01` — lists only the authenticated user's videos
- given: the user has already uploaded `video-samples/tiny-valid.mp4`
- when: GET /videos
- then:
  - response is `200` with `items` including that video's id, title, status, and `thumbnailUrl`
  - `total` equals the number of videos belonging to this user

## UI

**Verification mode:** Render the surface, drive it with user-like inputs (clicks, drag-and-drop, file selection); assert observable surface state (DOM, visible text, progress indicators).

### Upload

**Common given:** a user is logged in (a valid `videomax_session` cookie, reached through `/login`) on `/app`, with no prior videos.

#### `UI-UPLOAD-01` — drag-and-drop a valid file uploads and appears in the library
- given: (default)
- when: drop `video-samples/tiny-valid.mp4` onto the drop zone
- then:
  - a progress card appears showing the filename
  - once the upload completes, the video appears in the list with a "Validating" status badge
  - the extracted thumbnail is visible on the card (not a default placeholder image)

#### `UI-UPLOAD-02` — progress card shows percentage and bytes transferred
- given: (default)
- when: upload `video-samples/tiny-valid.mp4` via the file-picker button
- then:
  - the progress card shows the file's name
  - the progress card shows a percentage value
  - the progress card shows a bytes-transferred / total-size readout

#### `UI-UPLOAD-03` — oversized file rejected before transfer
- given: (default)
- when: select a file whose reported size exceeds 2GB
- then:
  - a toast shows "Files must be at most 2GB"
  - no progress card appears (no request was sent)

#### `UI-UPLOAD-04` — unsupported extension rejected before transfer
- given: (default)
- when: select `video-samples/unsupported-format.txt` via the file picker
- then:
  - a toast shows "Only MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, and AVI files are supported"
  - no progress card appears

#### `UI-UPLOAD-05` — user can keep browsing the library while an upload is in progress
- given: (default)
- when: start uploading `video-samples/tiny-valid.mp4`, then scroll and click within the video list while the upload is still in progress
- then:
  - the video list stays interactive (scroll and click are not blocked) while the upload runs
  - the upload eventually completes and the new video appears in the list

## E2E

**Verification mode:** Run the full system (frontend + backend + database); drive through a real browser; assert cross-stack behavior.

### Upload

#### `E2E-UPLOAD-01` — an uploaded video persists and survives reload
- given: a user is logged in on `/app` with no prior videos
- when: upload `video-samples/tiny-valid.mp4` via the drop zone, then reload the browser
- then:
  - after reload, the video still appears in the list with the same title and status
  - a video row exists in the database for this user with matching size and duration

#### `E2E-UPLOAD-02` — a second upload queues behind the first and both persist
- given: a user is logged in on `/app` with no prior videos
- when: select `video-samples/tiny-valid.mp4` twice in quick succession via the file picker
- then:
  - only one upload is in progress at a time — the second shows a queued/pending state until the first completes
  - after both finish, two video rows exist in the database for this user
